598:t_4:14.en:
$$ミネバ$$
「But revealing this monument's existence will shake the world to its core.」

598:t_4:15.en:
$$ミネバ$$
「Even if it belongs to only one world within the multiverse, the people of space will grow suspicious of the $$地球連邦$$.」

598:t_4:16.en:
$$ミネバ$$
「With the final battle against the $$新地球皇国$$ approaching, even I cannot imagine what that would cause.」

598:t_4:17.en:
$$ミネバ$$
「At the very least, as the price of good intentions... of truth, it is far too...!」

598:t_4:18.en:
$$サイアム$$
「That is why I entrusted this to you... to $$ニュータイプ$$s.」

598:t_4:19.en:
$$サイアム$$
「Because I believed you were the forerunners who would allow humanity to advance to the next stage.」

598:t_4:20.en:
$$ガエル$$
「The $$ラプラス・プログラム$$ is a system designed to identify true $$ニュータイプ$$s.」

598:t_4:21.en:
$$ガエル$$
「Unlike those of Cyber-Newtypes, a true $$ニュータイプ$$'s psychic waves transcend numerical values.」

598:t_4:22.en:
$$ガエル$$
「The key that guides a true $$ニュータイプ$$ to the Box, whoever they may be... That is the $$ユニコーンガンダム$$.」

598:t_4:23.en:
$$ガエル$$
「It was all planned by $$カーディアス・ビスト$$. He never dreamed that you would pilot it.」

598:t_5:3.en:
$$サイアム$$
「...Thanks to you, the moment I have awaited for so long has finally arrived.」

598:t_5:5.en:
$$サイアム$$
「As guardian of the Box, living far longer than any one body should, I had just one wish...」

598:t_5:6.en:
$$サイアム$$
「If $$ニュータイプ$$s truly existed, I wanted to entrust the Box to them...」

598:t_5:7.en:
$$サイアム$$
「I believed they would use it better and restore the future as it ought to be.」

598:t_5:8.en:
$$サイアム$$
「If technology capable of touching the human spirit... the heart... was nearing completion, I wanted to see for myself...」

598:t_5:9.en:
$$バナージ$$
「That is... the $$サイコ・フレーム$$...」

598:t_5:10.en:
$$サイアム$$
「But that is my wish... Each person has a wish of their own.」

598:t_5:11.en:
$$サイアム$$
「You may bury the truth and leave the Box unopened, or destroy it, if you wish.」

598:t_5:12.en:
$$サイアム$$
「If even that won't satisfy you... you may beat this old man to death.」

598:t_5:14.en:
$$サイアム$$
「What do you want? What do you wish for in your heart?」

598:t_5:15.en:
$$バナージ$$
「...If $$ニュータイプ$$s are a new form of humanity... I don't think people as we are now can recognize them.」

598:t_5:16.en:
$$バナージ$$
「So I don't know whether $$オードリー$$ and I have the qualities you seek, or what the best course is.」

598:t_5:18.en:
$$バナージ$$
「As a human being, I want to believe in what lies beyond... in people... in the possibilities people hold!」

598:t_5:19.en:
$$サイアム$$
「Then I will believe your words. If you wish to reveal the Box's contents to the world, the preparations should be in place.」

598:t_5:20.en:
$$ミネバ$$
「$$サイアム・ビスト$$... There is one thing I would like your opinion on.」

598:t_5:21.en:
$$ミネバ$$
「Did $$リカルド・マーセナス$$ do this out of guilt toward the space emigrants?」

598:t_5:23.en:
$$サイアム$$
「He was resisting that which binds this world.」

598:t_5:24.en:
$$バナージ$$
「Why can you say that so confidently?」

598:t_5:25.en:
$$サイアム$$
「I concealed the Box's existence for more than just bargaining with the Federation...」

598:t_5:28.en:
$$サイアム$$
「That day... as $$ラプラス$$ was engulfed in flames, I saw something.」

598:t_5:29.en:
$$サイアム$$
「The moment I saw that being, I understood the future $$リカルド$$ sought, and why he had to be killed.」

598:t_5:30.en:
$$サイアム$$
「That was $$クロノ$$'s doctrine itself... The reason they oppress $$スペースノイド$$s and call themselves watchers of humanity's evolution...」

598:t_5:31.en:
$$サイアム$$
「At the dawn of the $$宇宙世紀$$, $$リカルド・マーセナス$$ prayed for the future and intended to reveal the being that has bound us since ancient times.」

598:t_5:32.en:
$$ミネバ$$
「$$サイアム・ビスト$$... You...」

598:t_5:33.en:
$$サイアム$$
「Yes. The truth at the very bottom of $$ラプラスの箱$$... is me.」

598:t_5:34.en:
$$サイアム$$
「I am the only person outside $$クロノ$$ who knows and can speak of its doctrine... That is also why I have kept living.」

598:t_5:35.en:
$$バナージ$$
「What... exactly did you see?」

598:t_5:38.en:
$$バナージ$$
「The $$テンシ$$ $n saw... was actually $$アドヴェント#pilot$$...」

598:t_5:39.en:
$$バナージ$$
「Could he have been involved in the $$ラプラス事件$$, too...?」

598:t_5:42.en:
???
「But you... humanity... have no need to know that answer.」

598:t_5:44.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「Revealing $$ラプラスの箱$$ would also reveal $$クロノ$$'s doctrine, which lies beneath it.」

598:t_5:45.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「That despair would instead shut off all possibility... The Box's mere existence is enough.」

598:t_5:47.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「I would advise you to delve no deeper. Leave the rest to me.」

598:t_5:48.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「That is for humanity's sake.」

598:t_5:50.en:
$$ミネバ$$
「Stand down, $$フル・フロンタル$$. You are merely a man created in $$シャア$$'s image, trying to fulfill that role.」

598:t_5:51.en:
$$ミネバ$$
「Your talk of inheriting Earth's humanity is, to me, merely an escape for a man who does not believe in humanity's future.」

598:t_5:52.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「But that is humanity's collective will... It is the source of my power as its vessel.」

598:t_5:54.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「$$サイアム・ビスト$$, head of the $$ビスト家$$... As leader of $$ネオ・ジオン$$ and heir to Earth's humanity, I wish to take custody of $$ラプラスの箱$$.」

598:t_5:55.en:
$$サイアム$$
「You are not wrong... Perhaps the Box should remain closed so people can live in the reality before them.」

598:t_5:57.en:
$$サイアム$$
「Precisely for that reason, the decision to open the Box should not be left to people who see it only as a bargaining chip.」

598:t_5:58.en:
$$サイアム$$
「People like you and me...」

598:t_5:59.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「$$サイアム・ビスト$$!」

598:t_5:60.en:
$$サイアム$$
「I do not know what means you used, but you seem to know the Box's true meaning as well.」

598:t_5:61.en:
$$サイアム$$
「But, second $$赤い彗星$$, we cannot move into the future if we know that truth yet can do nothing.」

598:t_5:62.en:
$$サイアム$$
「Our time has passed... Can you not see that the time has come to entrust things to the children...?」

598:t_5:63.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「You mean they are the true $$ニュータイプ$$s, $$イノベイター$$s, and $$ＳＥＥＤ$$s, who should advance beyond the civilization of fire?」

598:t_5:64.en:
$$サイアム$$
「Exactly. Entrusting the future to them is the last task for me and the others.」

598:t_5:65.en:
$$サイアム$$
「But that is not what matters. After following the path to the Box, they made their decision. I wish to accept it.」

598:t_5:66.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「...Understood. Then I shall take the $$宇宙世紀$$ Charter by force.」

598:t_5:67.en:
$$サイアム$$
「I will not allow it...!」

598:t_5:68.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「A defense system!? You certainly leave nothing to chance!」

598:t_5:69.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「Then I'll attack $$メガラニカ$$ from outside!」

598:t_5:70.en:
$$バナージ$$
「$$フル・フロンタル$$!」

598:t_5:71.en:
$$ミネバ$$
「$$サイアム・ビスト$$! Are you all right!?」
